result.title: Sparse Autoencoders Are a Shared Coordinate System for Symbolic Matching
result.summary: Large language models (LLMs) hold broad knowledge in one set of weights, but lack interpretability and trustworthy reasoning, especially in high-stakes use cases. A neuro-symbolic model, with its interpretable architecture and System 2 reasoning capacity, is a promising alternative if built at the scale of LLMs; however, its symbolic backbone is usually constructed with human effort, so existing neuro-symbolic models are bottlenecked by the scope of the symbol component and usually domain-specific. A data-driven method could instead build a larger symbolic system by aligning and merging existing ones. We target its first, foundational step: matching units across these heterogeneous systems. Our method, SAE-IDF, encodes a symbol in its native context into a sparse code with a sparse autoencoder (SAE), re-weights each dimension by its rarity and matches across systems. On 12 tasks across 6 kinds of symbolic system, SAE-IDF outperforms the same LLM's dense baseline on all tasks with Gemma-2-9B and all but one with Llama-3.1-8B, by up to 45 points, consistently across SAE layers and configurations. SAE-IDF is also interpretable: every dimension of the sparse code has a human-readable meaning, so each match decomposes into named concepts (features). Our work paves the way to a universal symbolic backbone.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 SAE-IDF：用稀疏自编码器把符号在其原生上下文中编码为稀疏码，按维度稀有度重新加权，从而在不同异构符号系统间匹配单元；在 6 类符号系统的 12 个任务上优于同 LLM 的稠密基线，且稀疏码各维具有可读含义。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「稀疏特征 + 稀有度加权」的表示对齐方式，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的内容对齐、特征级相似度度量与可解释性分析提供方法线索，但研究对象是符号系统匹配而非视觉推理，迁移价值需核查。
